title: Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa Welcomes Dr. Jon Wilensky, MD, to Rancho Bernardo Location
text:
Rancho Bernardo, CA, April 30, 2025 – Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa is proud to announce the addition of board-certified plastic surgeon Jon Wilensky, MD, to its esteemed team of providers. Dr. Wilensky is now seeing patients at the practice’s Rancho Bernardo location, bringing with him a wealth of experience, innovation, and a deep passion for delivering customized, transformative outcomes in aesthetic surgery.
With more than a decade of expertise, Dr. Wilensky is widely recognized for his skill in breast enhancement , body contouring , and buttock procedures . His arrival strengthens Renuance’s position as a leader in advanced cosmetic treatments across Southern California and reflects the practice’s continued commitment to expanding access to premier, patient-focused care.
Dr. Wilensky earned his medical degree from the University of Michigan Medical School, one of the top-ranked institutions in the country. He then completed his plastic surgery residency at UC San Diego, where he received extensive training in both reconstructive and cosmetic surgery. During his time at UC San Diego, he honed a comprehensive, detail-oriented approach that continues to define his practice today.
Before joining Renuance, Dr. Wilensky served patients in the greater San Diego area, earning widespread recognition for his surgical precision, attentive bedside manner, and dedication to patient education. His ability to combine artistic vision with medical expertise allows him to craft highly personalized treatment plans that align with each individual’s goals and natural anatomy.
Known for his down-to-earth demeanor, approachability, and honest communication, Dr. Wilensky builds strong relationships with his patients—fostering a sense of trust and empowerment throughout every step of their aesthetic journey.
“I’m excited to join the talented team at Renuance and to serve patients in the Rancho Bernardo and San Diego community,” said Dr. Wilensky. “My approach has always centered on listening first—understanding each patient’s unique vision—and then applying the most advanced surgical techniques to help them look and feel their best. Renuance shares that same commitment to personalized, patient-first care.”
With the addition of Dr. Wilensky, Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa continues to grow its regional presence while maintaining the high-touch, boutique-level service that has earned the practice its outstanding reputation over the past 20 years. The Rancho Bernardo location now offers an expanded menu of surgical options, making it more convenient than ever for patients to access cutting-edge aesthetic procedures close to home.
The Renuance team is enthusiastic about this next chapter.
“We are thrilled to welcome Dr. Wilensky to the Renuance family,” said the team at Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa. “His surgical excellence, patient-centric approach, and collaborative spirit align perfectly with our mission. We are confident that his presence will enrich our practice and have a meaningful impact on the lives of our patients.”
Patients who are interested in scheduling a consultation with Dr. Jon Wilensky at the Rancho Bernardo office are encouraged to call the practice or visit the website at https://renuance.net/ to learn more.
About Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa
Renuance Cosmetic Surgery & MedSpa has been a trusted leader in aesthetic care for over 20 years, serving patients throughout Southern California with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and personalized treatment. Led by a team of experienced, board-certified plastic surgeons, Renuance offers a full spectrum of surgical and non-surgical procedures designed to help patients look and feel their best. With state-of-the-art facilities in Murrieta and Rancho Bernardo, the practice combines advanced medical expertise with a warm, patient-centered approach—delivering natural-looking results in a safe, supportive environment.
